maria: Heads up — docs build failing after the anchor migration. Several in-page links to /guides/serving are 404ing on the preview site. maria: CI preview shows link resolution errors for anchors like #warm-start and #kv-cache. jonathan: Can you paste the CI error output? maria: From docs-preview job: ``` Error: could not resolve link 'guides/serving.md#warm-start' referenced from 'guides/overview.md' Warning: duplicate anchor id 'warm-start' found in docs/guides/serving.md ``` sasha: This smells like the unicode hyphen/normalization problem we hit migrating from MkDocs -> Docusaurus. Some files have a non-breaking hyphen or U+2011 which becomes a different id after slugging. sasha: Example: the heading 'Warm‑start' in serving.md uses U+2011 (looks identical) which slugifies to warm011start on some toolchains and breaks internal links. tiago: Quick repro: run `yarn build` locally and inspect the static html id attributes. You can also run `node ./tools/slug-check.js` to list mismatched anchors. jonathan: I ran that and got the duplicate-anchor warning too. Also saw this when opening the generated html: ```
``` maria: So we need two things: normalize existing headings to ascii-safe hyphens and add a CI linter to catch non-ascii punctuation in headings. sasha: I'll open a tiny PR that normalizes headings using a script and updates the affected pages. Will include tests. sasha: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/872 (draft) — includes scripts/normalize-anchors.py and a short README note. tiago: I can add a step in docs-preview CI to run `python scripts/normalize-anchors.py --check` and fail on diffs. Also will add `node ./tools/check-anchors.js` which compares resolved hrefs against generated ids. jonathan: Can we also add a pre-commit hook so contributors see the warning earlier? husky or pre-commit would work. maria: Yes please. Also update the contributor guide to call out "use ascii hyphen-minus (-) for headings" and link to the script. sasha: One more oddity: some markdown editors auto-replaced hyphens with unicode variants. I added that note to the PR. build-bot: docs-preview failed for commit 3f2a9d8 — see pipeline: https://ci.internal.redwood/dev/docs/3456 maria: Thanks — assigning owners: sasha for the normalization PR, tiago for CI gating, jonathan for the pre-commit hook, and i'll update docs contribution guide. sasha: I'll post the PR updates here when ready. jonathan: After the PR lands can someone re-run the preview job so we can verify the netlify/static preview? tiago: Yup, will rerun and post the preview URL. maria: Checklist for follow-up: - normalize headings in affected pages - add CI check to fail on unresolved anchors - add pre-commit hook to warn on non-ascii punctuation in headings - update contributor guide with linking conventions sasha: PR updated, tests included. build-bot: preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.dev/guides/serving?pr=872 maria: Verified the preview — links resolved, anchor ids normalized. Great work. :thumbsup: jonathan: Can we also add a small note in the release notes about anchor normalization so docs maintainers are aware? maria: Good idea, i'll add it to the 2025.07 docs changelog. sasha: done. Closing this thread once CI has been green for 24 hours. maria: sounds good, thanks everyone!
